seo.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
seo.description: Find the answers to your questions about Renaissance Eyewear glasses: orders, shipping, returns, care, warranty and partner opticians.

paymentMethods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.a: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers. All payments are secure and encrypted.

modifyOrder.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
modifyOrder.a: You can change or cancel your order within 2 hours of placing it by contacting us right away. After that, your order is being prepared.

invoice.a: Yes, a detailed invoice is sent to you by email as soon as your order ships.

deliveryTimes.a: Orders ship within 24 to 48h. Delivery takes 1 to 2 business days in metropolitan France, 2 to 3 days in the EU, and 3 to 7 days internationally.

freeShipping.a: Yes, shipping is free on all orders, wherever they go.

trackOrder.a: Yes, you'll receive a tracking number by email as soon as your order ships. You can follow your parcel in real time.

internationalShipping.a: Yes, we ship worldwide. Customs fees may apply depending on the country and are the recipient's responsibility.

returnPolicy.a: You have 14 days from delivery to return your order. The product must be in its original condition with the packaging intact. Return shipping is covered by Renaissance.

howToReturn.q: How do I make a return?
howToReturn.a: Contact our customer service at contact@renaissanceeyewear.com with your order number. We'll send you a prepaid return label and the instructions.

refundDelay.a: The refund is issued within 14 days of receiving and approving your return, to the payment method used for the purchase.

exchangeFrame.a: Yes, we offer free exchanges. Contact us to arrange the exchange of your frame.

chooseSize.q: How do I choose the right frame size?
chooseSize.a: Check our Size Guide, which lists the dimensions of each model. You can also try our frames at one of our 250+ partner opticians.

prescriptionLenses.q: Can the frames take prescription lenses?
prescriptionLenses.a: Yes, all our optical frames can take your prescription lenses. Visit a partner optician for the fitting.

cleanGlasses.q: How do I care for my Renaissance glasses?
cleanGlasses.a: Clean your glasses with the microfiber cloth provided. Avoid harsh chemicals. Keep them in their case when you're not wearing them.

warranty.q: What is the warranty on the frames?
warranty.a: All our frames come with a 3-year manufacturer's warranty covering manufacturing defects.

tryBeforeBuy.q: Can I try the glasses before buying?
tryBeforeBuy.a: Yes, visit one of our 250+ partner opticians in France to try our collections and get personalized advice.

findOptician.q: How do I find a partner optician?
findOptician.a: Use our optician locator on the "Find an Optician" page to find the nearest point of sale.

samePrices.q: Are prices the same online and at opticians?
samePrices.a: Yes, our prices are the same on our site and at our partner opticians.

contactService.q: How do I contact customer service?
contactService.a: You can reach us by email at contact@renaissanceeyewear.com or by phone at +33 (0)3 55 18 66 84 (Mon to Fri, 9am to 6pm).

responseDelay.q: How quickly does customer service reply?
responseDelay.a: We commit to answering every request within 48 business hours at most.

customization.q: Do you offer a customization service?
customization.a: Contact us to discuss your customization needs. Some options may be available on request.
